objects.description: Opaque runtime object for the QuickJS engine. Forward-declared here; definition is not present in this header.
Opaque execution context associated with a JSRuntime. Forward-declared here; definition is not present in this header.
Opaque JavaScript object handle. Forward-declared; concrete structure not defined in this header.
Opaque internal QuickJS class metadata structure. Forward-declared here; definition not included in this header.
Reference-count header used internally for ref-counted QuickJS heap objects. Holds a single ref_count field.
Storage union backing JSValue in non-NaN-boxing builds. Holds either 32-bit int, double, or pointer.

Tagged value representing any JavaScript value. Representation varies by build-time config; this struct form is used when JS_NAN_BOXING is not enabled. JSValueConst is an alias to JSValue in this header. Construction helpers like JS_NewInt32/JS_NewFloat64 create values; lifetime management via JS_DupValue/JS_FreeValue.
State passed to custom allocator callbacks. Tracks allocation counts/sizes and carries a user opaque pointer.
Set of function pointers implementing custom memory allocation for a runtime. Pass to JS_NewRuntime2.

Descriptor used when enumerating object property keys; carries the atom id and enumerability.
Property descriptor used by get_own_property-like hooks and JS_GetOwnProperty. Contains flags and optional value/getter/setter values.
Optional per-class virtual methods to customize property semantics (exotic objects).
Definition used to register a custom QuickJS class, including name, finalizer, GC mark, optional call behavior, and exotic methods table.

functions.name: JS_NewRuntime
functions.description: Create a new QuickJS runtime instance. Use as the root allocator/GC and for creating contexts.
requirements: Must be paired with JS_FreeRuntime to avoid leaks.
Returns NULL on failure; caller must check for NULL before use.

functions.name: JS_SetRuntimeInfo
functions.description: Attach an informational string to the runtime (for debugging/diagnostics).
requirements: rt must be a valid JSRuntime* created by JS_NewRuntime/JS_NewRuntime2.
info must outlive rt (comment: "info lifetime must exceed that of rt").

functions.name: JS_SetMemoryLimit
functions.description: Set the maximum memory that the runtime may allocate.
requirements: rt must be a valid JSRuntime*.
limit is in bytes; use an appropriate value for your environment.

functions.name: JS_SetGCThreshold
functions.description: Set the garbage collection trigger threshold for the runtime.
requirements: rt must be a valid JSRuntime*.
gc_threshold is in bytes; choose based on memory behavior.

functions.name: JS_SetMaxStackSize
functions.description: Set maximum JS stack size for stack overflow checks. Use 0 to disable check.
requirements: rt must be a valid JSRuntime*.
Passing 0 disables the maximum stack size check.

functions.name: JS_UpdateStackTop
functions.description: Update internal saved stack-top for overflow checks; call when changing thread using the runtime.
requirements: rt must be a valid JSRuntime*.
Should be called after switching threads that use the same runtime.

functions.name: JS_NewRuntime2
functions.description: Create a new runtime using custom malloc/realloc/free hooks and user opaque pointer.
requirements: mf may be NULL or must point to a fully initialized JSMallocFunctions if custom allocation is desired.
opaque is stored in the runtime and later retrievable via JS_GetRuntimeOpaque.
Check return for NULL before use.

functions.name: JS_FreeRuntime
functions.description: Destroy a runtime and free all associated resources, contexts, and objects.
requirements: rt must have been created by JS_NewRuntime/JS_NewRuntime2.
All contexts created from rt must not be used after this call.
Must not be called twice on the same rt.

functions.name: JS_GetRuntimeOpaque
functions.description: Get the user-provided opaque pointer associated with the runtime.
requirements: rt must be a valid JSRuntime*.

functions.name: JS_SetRuntimeOpaque
functions.description: Set the user opaque pointer on the runtime for application use.
requirements: rt must be a valid JSRuntime*.

functions.name: JS_MarkValue
functions.description: Mark a JS value for GC (used by embedders to integrate custom GC objects).
requirements: mark_func must be a valid function pointer when provided.
val may be any JSValue; function will mark reachable objects.

functions.name: JS_RunGC
functions.description: Trigger a garbage collection cycle for the runtime.

functions.name: JS_IsLiveObject
functions.description: Return whether obj is a live object in the runtime (not collected).
requirements: obj should be a JS object value (tag JS_TAG_OBJECT); other tags may return false.

functions.name: JS_NewContext
functions.description: Create a new JS execution context associated with the given runtime, with standard intrinsics.
requirements: rt must be a valid runtime.
Returns NULL on failure; check result before use.

functions.name: JS_FreeContext
functions.description: Free a JS context and its resources.
requirements: s must be a context created by JS_NewContext/JS_NewContextRaw.
Must not be used after freeing.

functions.name: JS_DupContext
functions.description: Increase the reference count of a context and return it (duplicate handle).
requirements: ctx must be a valid JSContext*.
Must eventually be balanced with JS_FreeContext.

functions.name: JS_GetContextOpaque
functions.description: Get user-provided opaque pointer stored on a context.
requirements: ctx must be a valid JSContext*.

functions.name: JS_SetContextOpaque
functions.description: Set a user opaque pointer on a context for application data.
requirements: ctx must be a valid JSContext*.

functions.name: JS_GetRuntime
functions.description: Get the runtime that owns the given context.
requirements: ctx must be a valid JSContext*.

functions.name: JS_SetClassProto
functions.signature: void JS_SetClassProto(JSContext *ctx, JSClassID class_id, JSValue obj);
functions.description: Associate a prototype object with a class ID in the context.
requirements: obj is consumed (JSValue) by the engine; follow QuickJS ownership rules.
class_id must be a previously obtained/registered class ID.

functions.name: JS_GetClassProto
functions.description: Get the prototype object associated with a class ID.
requirements: Returns a JSValue; caller must free it with JS_FreeValue when done or check for exception via JS_IsException.

functions.name: JS_NewContextRaw
functions.description: Create a new context without adding standard intrinsic objects; add them manually to save memory.
requirements: Returns NULL on failure; free with JS_FreeContext.
After creation, call JS_AddIntrinsic* functions as needed.

functions.name: JS_AddIntrinsicBaseObjects
functions.description: Add base intrinsic objects (Object, Function, etc.) to a raw context.
requirements: ctx must be a context (often from JS_NewContextRaw).

functions.name: JS_AddIntrinsicDate
functions.description: Add Date intrinsic to the context.

functions.name: JS_AddIntrinsicEval
functions.description: Add eval-related intrinsics to the context.

functions.name: JS_AddIntrinsicStringNormalize
functions.description: Add String normalization intrinsics (Unicode normalization) to the context.

functions.name: JS_AddIntrinsicRegExpCompiler
functions.description: Add RegExp compiler support to the context.

functions.name: JS_AddIntrinsicRegExp
functions.description: Add RegExp objects/methods to the context.

functions.name: JS_AddIntrinsicJSON
functions.description: Add JSON object and functions to the context.

functions.name: JS_AddIntrinsicProxy
functions.description: Add Proxy support to the context.

functions.name: JS_AddIntrinsicMapSet
functions.description: Add Map and Set intrinsics to the context.

functions.name: JS_AddIntrinsicTypedArrays
functions.description: Add TypedArray and ArrayBuffer intrinsics to the context.

functions.name: JS_AddIntrinsicPromise
functions.description: Add Promise intrinsics to the context.

functions.name: JS_AddIntrinsicBigInt
functions.description: Enable BigInt support in the context.

functions.name: JS_AddIntrinsicBigFloat
functions.description: Enable BigFloat support in the context.

functions.name: JS_AddIntrinsicBigDecimal
functions.description: Enable BigDecimal support in the context.

functions.name: JS_AddIntrinsicOperators
functions.description: Enable operator overloading support in the context.

functions.name: JS_EnableBignumExt
functions.description: Enable or disable "use math" bignum extensions for the context.

functions.name: js_string_codePointRange
functions.signature: JSValue js_string_codePointRange(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst this_val, int argc, JSValueConst *argv);
functions.description: Internal helper to operate on string code point ranges (exact semantics not documented here).
requirements: Returns a JSValue; caller must free it or handle exception with JS_IsException.
Arguments follow QuickJS C function calling convention.

functions.name: js_malloc_rt
functions.description: Allocate memory using the runtime's allocator.
requirements: rt must be a valid JSRuntime*.
Returns NULL on allocation failure; caller must handle NULL.

functions.name: js_free_rt
functions.description: Free memory previously allocated with js_malloc_rt/js_realloc_rt for the same runtime.
requirements: ptr must have been allocated by this runtime's allocator.

functions.name: js_realloc_rt
functions.description: Reallocate memory using the runtime's allocator.
requirements: ptr must be from the same allocator or NULL for fresh alloc.
Returns NULL on failure; original block may be freed or preserved per allocator semantics.

functions.name: js_malloc_usable_size_rt
functions.description: Return allocator-reported usable size of an allocation made via runtime allocator.
requirements: ptr must be from this allocator; undefined otherwise.

functions.name: js_mallocz_rt
functions.description: Allocate zero-initialized memory via the runtime allocator.

functions.name: js_malloc
functions.description: Allocate memory using the context's allocator.

functions.name: js_free
functions.description: Free memory previously allocated with js_malloc/js_realloc for the same context/runtime.
requirements: ptr must come from the same runtime allocator family.

functions.name: js_realloc
functions.description: Reallocate memory using the context's allocator.
requirements: ptr must be NULL or from same allocator.

functions.name: js_malloc_usable_size
functions.description: Return usable size of an allocation made via the context/runtime allocator.
requirements: ptr must be from same allocator; otherwise undefined.

functions.name: js_realloc2
functions.description: Reallocate memory and optionally return slack bytes available in the block.
requirements: ptr must be NULL or from same allocator.
pslack may be NULL; if non-NULL, it receives slack size.

functions.name: js_mallocz
functions.description: Allocate zero-initialized memory via the context's allocator.

functions.name: js_strdup
functions.description: Duplicate a C string using the context allocator.
requirements: str must be a valid NUL-terminated string.

functions.name: js_strndup
functions.description: Duplicate up to n bytes of a C string using the context allocator; result is NUL-terminated.
requirements: s must point to readable memory of at least n bytes or NUL earlier.

functions.name: JS_ComputeMemoryUsage
functions.description: Fill a JSMemoryUsage structure with current memory usage counters for the runtime.
requirements: s must be a valid pointer to a JSMemoryUsage to be written.

functions.name: JS_DumpMemoryUsage
functions.description: Dump a human-readable memory usage report to the given FILE* based on JSMemoryUsage.
requirements: fp must be a valid writable FILE*.
s must point to a previously filled JSMemoryUsage.
rt must be the runtime used to gather stats.

functions.name: JS_NewAtomLen
functions.signature: JSAtom JS_NewAtomLen(JSContext *ctx, const char *str, size_t len);
functions.description: Create/intern a new atom from a string with explicit length.
requirements: str must point to at least len bytes; not necessarily NUL-terminated.
Returns 0 on failure (JS_ATOM_NULL) or a valid atom.

functions.name: JS_NewAtom
functions.description: Create/intern a new atom from a NUL-terminated string.
requirements: str must be a valid NUL-terminated string.

functions.name: JS_NewAtomUInt32
functions.description: Create/intern an atom representing the decimal form of an unsigned 32-bit number or an index.

functions.name: JS_DupAtom
functions.description: Increase reference count of an atom and return it (no-op for immortal atoms).
requirements: v must be a previously obtained atom.

functions.name: JS_FreeAtom
functions.description: Decrease reference count of an atom; free when reaching zero.
requirements: v must be a valid atom obtained from this context/runtime.

functions.name: JS_FreeAtomRT
functions.description: Decrease reference count of an atom using just the runtime.
requirements: v must be a valid atom for this runtime.

functions.name: JS_AtomToValue
functions.description: Convert an atom to a JS string value.
requirements: Returns JSValue; caller must free or handle exception.

functions.name: JS_AtomToString
functions.description: Alias/convert atom to a JS string value (string object).

functions.name: JS_AtomToCString
functions.description: Return a transient C string representation of an atom.
requirements: Returned pointer must be freed with JS_FreeCString when done.

functions.name: JS_ValueToAtom
functions.description: Convert a JS value to an atom (interned property key).
requirements: val should be a string/symbol/number convertible to property key.

functions.name: JS_NewAtomWithSymbol
functions.description: Create an atom and an associated Symbol for the given description string.

functions.name: JS_SymbolGetIterator
functions.description: Return the global well-known Symbol.iterator value.
requirements: Caller owns returned value; free when done or handle exception.

functions.name: JS_SymbolToStringTag
functions.description: Return the global well-known Symbol.toStringTag value.
requirements: Caller owns returned value; free when done or handle exception.

functions.name: JS_SymbolGetIteratorAtom
functions.description: Return the atom corresponding to Symbol.iterator.

functions.name: JS_SymbolToStringTagAtom
functions.description: Return the atom corresponding to Symbol.toStringTag.

functions.name: JS_NewClassID
functions.description: Allocate a new unique class ID; optionally store it via pclass_id.
requirements: pclass_id may be NULL; if non-NULL, receives the new ID.

functions.name: JS_NewClass
functions.signature: int JS_NewClass(JSRuntime *rt, JSClassID class_id, const JSClassDef *class_def);
functions.description: Register a class with the runtime, providing callbacks and exotic methods.
requirements: class_def must point to a valid JSClassDef that outlives registration if referenced.

functions.name: JS_IsRegisteredClass
functions.description: Check if a class ID has been registered with the runtime.

functions.name: JS_NewBigInt64
functions.description: Create a BigInt JSValue from a signed 64-bit integer.
requirements: Caller owns returned JSValue; free or handle exception.

functions.name: JS_NewBigUint64
functions.description: Create a BigInt JSValue from an unsigned 64-bit integer.
requirements: Caller owns returned JSValue; free or handle exception.

functions.name: JS_IsInteger
functions.description: Return whether value is an integer (JS_TAG_INT or BigInt).

functions.name: JS_IsNumber
functions.description: Return whether value is a number (int or float).

functions.name: JS_IsBigInt
functions.signature: static inline JS_BOOL JS_IsBigInt(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst v);
functions.description: Return whether value is a BigInt.
requirements: ctx must be valid (unused in current inline but kept for API).

functions.name: JS_IsBigFloat
functions.description: Return whether value is a BigFloat.

functions.name: JS_IsBigDecimal
functions.description: Return whether value is a BigDecimal.

functions.name: JS_IsBool
functions.description: Return whether value is a boolean.

functions.name: JS_IsNull
functions.description: Return whether value is null.

functions.name: JS_IsUndefined
functions.description: Return whether value is undefined.

functions.name: JS_IsException
functions.description: Return whether value is the QuickJS exception sentinel.

functions.name: JS_IsUninitialized
functions.description: Return whether value is the uninitialized sentinel.

functions.name: JS_IsString
functions.description: Return whether value is a string.

functions.name: JS_IsSymbol
functions.description: Return whether value is a symbol.

functions.name: JS_IsObject
functions.description: Return whether value is an object.

functions.name: JS_IsRegExp
functions.description: Return whether value is a RegExp object.

functions.name: JS_IsSet
functions.description: Return whether value is a Set object.

functions.name: JS_IsPromise
functions.description: Return whether value is a Promise object.

functions.name: JS_IsProxy
functions.description: Return whether value is a Proxy object.

functions.name: JS_IsArrayBuffer
functions.description: Return whether value is an ArrayBuffer.

functions.name: JS_IsArrayBufferView
functions.description: Return whether value is a typed array/DataView (ArrayBuffer view).

functions.name: JS_IsWhatTypedArray
functions.description: Return whether value is a specific TypedArray kind.
requirements: type must be a valid JS_TYPED_ARRAY enum value.

functions.name: JS_Throw
functions.description: Throw a JS exception value in the context, returning the exception sentinel.
requirements: obj is consumed by the engine.
Return must be checked with JS_IsException.

functions.name: JS_GetException
functions.description: Retrieve and clear the pending exception from the context.
requirements: Caller owns returned value; free when done.

functions.name: JS_IsError
functions.description: Return whether val is an Error object in the given context.

functions.name: JS_ResetUncatchableError
functions.description: Reset the uncatchable error state flag in the context.

functions.name: JS_NewError
functions.description: Create a new generic Error object.

functions.name: JS_ThrowSyntaxError
functions.description: Format and throw a SyntaxError in the context. printf-like formatting.
requirements: fmt must be a valid format string; additional args as required.
Return is exception sentinel; typical use is to return it from C functions.

functions.name: JS_ThrowTypeError
functions.description: Format and throw a TypeError in the context.

functions.name: JS_ThrowReferenceError
functions.description: Format and throw a ReferenceError in the context.

functions.name: JS_ThrowRangeError
functions.description: Format and throw a RangeError in the context.

functions.name: JS_ThrowInternalError
functions.description: Format and throw an internal Error in the context.

functions.name: JS_ThrowOutOfMemory
functions.description: Throw an out-of-memory exception.

functions.name: JS_FreeValue
functions.description: Decrease reference and free a JSValue in the given context/runtime when it becomes unreachable.
requirements: v must belong to the same runtime.

functions.name: JS_FreeValueRT
functions.description: Free a JSValue using only the runtime pointer (for finalizers).
requirements: v must belong to the same runtime.

functions.name: JS_DupValue
functions.description: Duplicate a JSValue (increase reference count) and return it.
requirements: v must belong to the same runtime.

functions.name: JS_DupValueRT
functions.description: Duplicate a JSValue using a runtime pointer.
requirements: v must belong to the runtime.

functions.name: JS_CloneValue
functions.description: Clone an object with a fast shallow copy; sub-values are shared with the original.
requirements: v should be an object; other types may be returned as-is or per implementation.
Caller owns returned value or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_ToBool
functions.description: Convert a JS value to boolean; returns -1 on exception, otherwise 0/1.
requirements: Check return for -1 and handle exception via JS_GetException.

functions.name: JS_ToInt32
functions.description: Convert a JS value to int32; returns 0 on success, -1 on exception.
requirements: pres must be non-NULL to receive result.

functions.name: JS_ToInt64
functions.description: Convert a JS value to int64; returns 0 on success, -1 on exception.

functions.name: JS_ToIndex
functions.description: Convert a JS value to a non-negative integer index per JS ToIndex; returns 0 or -1 on exception.

functions.name: JS_ToFloat64
functions.description: Convert a JS value to double; returns 0 on success, -1 on exception.

functions.name: JS_ToBigInt64
functions.description: Convert a JS BigInt value to int64; returns exception if val is a Number.
requirements: Fails if val is a Number (per comment).

functions.name: JS_ToInt64Ext
functions.description: Convert to int64 accepting both Number and BigInt; returns 0 or -1 on exception.

functions.name: JS_NewStringLen
functions.signature: JSValue JS_NewStringLen(JSContext *ctx, const char *str1, size_t len1);
functions.description: Create a new JS string from bytes with explicit length.
requirements: str1 must point to at least len1 bytes.
Caller owns returned value or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_NewString
functions.description: Create a new JS string from a NUL-terminated C string.
requirements: Caller owns returned value or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_NewAtomString
functions.description: Create a new JS string that may be atomized/optimized for property keys.

functions.name: JS_ToString
functions.description: Convert a JS value to string (ToString); returns a JS string or exception.
requirements: Caller owns returned value; check for exception.

functions.name: JS_ToPropertyKey
functions.description: Convert a JS value to a property key (string or symbol); returns JSValue or exception.
requirements: Caller owns returned value; check for exception.

functions.name: JS_ToCStringLen2
functions.signature: const char *JS_ToCStringLen2(JSContext *ctx, size_t *plen, JSValueConst val1, JS_BOOL cesu8);
functions.description: Convert a JS value to a UTF-8 (or CESU-8 if cesu8) C string; optionally return byte length.
requirements: Returned pointer must be freed with JS_FreeCString.
plen may be NULL; if non-NULL receives length excluding NUL.

functions.name: JS_FreeCString
functions.description: Free a C string previously returned by JS_ToCString/JS_AtomToCString.
requirements: ptr must be a pointer returned by a QuickJS C-string-returning API for this context/runtime; may be NULL.

functions.name: JS_NewObjectProtoClass
functions.signature: JSValue JS_NewObjectProtoClass(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst proto, JSClassID class_id);
functions.description: Create a new object with the given prototype and class ID.
requirements: proto must be an object or null.
Caller owns returned object or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_NewObjectClass
functions.description: Create a new object with the specified class ID and default prototype.
requirements: Caller owns returned value or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_NewObjectProto
functions.description: Create a new plain object with the given prototype.
requirements: proto should be object or null.

functions.name: JS_NewObject
functions.description: Create a new plain object with default Object.prototype.

functions.name: JS_IsFunction
functions.description: Return whether val is a function object.

functions.name: JS_IsConstructor
functions.description: Return whether val is a constructor function.

functions.name: JS_SetConstructorBit
functions.signature: JS_BOOL JS_SetConstructorBit(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst func_obj, JS_BOOL val);
functions.description: Set or clear the constructor bit on a function object to control constructor calls.
requirements: func_obj must be a function object.
Returns non-zero on success or zero on failure.

functions.name: JS_NewArray
functions.description: Create a new Array object.

functions.name: JS_IsArray
functions.description: Check if val is an Array; returns 1 if true, 0 if false, or <0 on exception.

functions.name: JS_GetPropertyInternal
functions.signature: JSValue JS_GetPropertyInternal(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst obj, JSAtom prop, JSValueConst receiver, JS_BOOL throw_ref_error);
functions.description: Low-level property access with explicit receiver and option to throw on undefined reference.
requirements: obj must be an object value.
Returns property value or exception; caller owns returned value.

functions.name: JS_GetProperty
functions.signature: static js_force_inline JSValue JS_GetProperty(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst this_obj, JSAtom prop);
functions.description: Convenience wrapper for JS_GetPropertyInternal using this_obj as receiver and without throwing on undefined.
requirements: Caller owns returned value or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_GetPropertyStr
functions.signature: JSValue JS_GetPropertyStr(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst this_obj, const char *prop);
functions.description: Get a property by C-string name.
requirements: prop must be a NUL-terminated string.
Caller owns returned value or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_GetPropertyUint32
functions.signature: JSValue JS_GetPropertyUint32(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst this_obj, uint32_t idx);
functions.description: Get a property by array index (uint32).
requirements: Caller owns returned value or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_SetPropertyInternal
functions.signature: int JS_SetPropertyInternal(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst this_obj, JSAtom prop, JSValue val, int flags);

functions.name: JS_SetProperty
functions.signature: static inline int JS_SetProperty(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst this_obj, JSAtom prop, JSValue val);
functions.description: Set a property with default behavior that throws on failure (JS_PROP_THROW).
requirements: On return -1, an exception is pending.

functions.name: JS_SetPropertyInternal2
functions.signature: int JS_SetPropertyInternal2(JSContext* ctx, JSValueConst this_obj, JSAtom prop, JSValue val, int flags, JS_BOOL focus_ignore_writable, JS_BOOL ignore_hook);
functions.description: Extended property setter with extra controls for writable and hooks.

functions.name: JS_SetPropertyFocus
functions.signature: static inline int JS_SetPropertyFocus(JSContext* ctx, JSValueConst this_obj, JSAtom prop, JSValue val);
functions.description: Helper calling JS_SetPropertyInternal2 with focus_ignore_writable=1, ignore_hook=0.

functions.name: JS_OrOpPropertyFlags
functions.signature: int JS_OrOpPropertyFlags(JSContext* ctx, JSValueConst this_obj, JSAtom prop, int flags);
functions.description: Bitwise-OR additional flags into a property's flags.
requirements: Returns 0 on success or -1 on exception.

functions.name: JS_SetPropertyUint32
functions.signature: int JS_SetPropertyUint32(JSContext* ctx, JSValueConst this_obj, uint32_t idx, JSValue val);
functions.description: Set a property by numeric index.

functions.name: JS_SetPropertyInt64
functions.signature: int JS_SetPropertyInt64(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst this_obj, int64_t idx, JSValue val);
functions.description: Set a property by 64-bit integer index.

functions.name: JS_SetPropertyStr
functions.signature: int JS_SetPropertyStr(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst this_obj, const char *prop, JSValue val);
functions.description: Set a property by C-string name.

functions.name: JS_HasProperty
functions.signature: int JS_HasProperty(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst this_obj, JSAtom prop);
functions.description: Test if an object has a property; returns 1 if present, 0 if not, -1 on exception.

functions.name: JS_IsExtensible
functions.description: Return 1 if object is extensible, 0 if not, or <0 on exception.

functions.name: JS_PreventExtensions
functions.description: Make an object non-extensible; returns 0 on success, -1 on exception.

functions.name: JS_DeleteProperty
functions.signature: int JS_DeleteProperty(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst obj, JSAtom prop, int flags);
functions.description: Delete a property with flags; returns 1 if deleted, 0 if not, or -1 on exception.

functions.name: JS_SetPrototype
functions.signature: int JS_SetPrototype(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst obj, JSValueConst proto_val);
functions.description: Set an object's prototype; returns 0 on success, -1 on exception.
requirements: proto_val must be object or null.

functions.name: JS_GetPrototype
functions.description: Get an object's prototype; returns prototype or exception.
requirements: Caller owns returned value; free or handle exception.

functions.name: JS_GetPrototypeFree
functions.signature: static inline JSValue JS_GetPrototypeFree(JSContext* ctx, JSValue obj);
functions.description: Get prototype of obj and free obj, returning the prototype.
requirements: obj is consumed (freed) by this call.

functions.name: JS_GetOwnPropertyNames
functions.signature: int JS_GetOwnPropertyNames(JSContext *ctx, JSPropertyEnum **ptab, uint32_t *plen, JSValueConst obj, int flags);
functions.description: Enumerate own property keys of an object into an array of JSPropertyEnum.
requirements: ptab and plen must be non-NULL to receive results.
On success, caller must free the table with JS_FreePropEnum.
flags control which keys (strings/symbols/private, enumerable only, etc.).

functions.name: JS_FreePropEnum
functions.signature: void JS_FreePropEnum(JSContext* ctx, JSPropertyEnum* tab, uint32_t len);
functions.description: Free a property enumeration table obtained from JS_GetOwnPropertyNames.
requirements: tab must be the pointer returned by JS_GetOwnPropertyNames.
len must match the length returned.

functions.name: JS_GetOwnProperty
functions.signature: int JS_GetOwnProperty(JSContext *ctx, JSPropertyDescriptor *desc, JSValueConst obj, JSAtom prop);
functions.description: Get the own property descriptor for a property; fills desc.
requirements: desc may be NULL (in which case only presence is determined based on return).
Returns <0 on exception, 0/1 depending on existence per QuickJS semantics.

functions.name: JS_Call
functions.signature: JSValue JS_Call(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst func_obj, JSValueConst this_obj, int argc, JSValueConst *argv);
functions.description: Call a JS function with given this and arguments.
requirements: func_obj must be a callable function.
argv must point to at least argc JSValueConst entries (may be 0/NULL).
Caller owns returned value or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_Invoke
functions.signature: JSValue JS_Invoke(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst this_val, JSAtom atom, int argc, JSValueConst *argv);
functions.description: Invoke a method on this_val by property atom with arguments.
requirements: argv must be at least argc long.
Caller owns returned value or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_CallConstructor
functions.signature: JSValue JS_CallConstructor(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst func_obj, int argc, JSValueConst *argv);
functions.description: Call a constructor function with 'new' semantics.
requirements: func_obj must be a constructor-capable function.
argv must supply at least argc entries.
Caller owns returned value or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_CallConstructor2
functions.signature: JSValue JS_CallConstructor2(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst func_obj, JSValueConst new_target, int argc, JSValueConst *argv);
functions.description: Call a constructor with an explicit new.target.
requirements: new_target must be a constructor function object.
Caller owns returned value or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_DetectModule
functions.description: Heuristically detect if the given source text is an ES module.
requirements: input must be a buffer of at least input_len+1 bytes with input[input_len]=='\0' (comment requirement).

functions.name: JS_Eval
functions.signature: JSValue JS_Eval(JSContext *ctx, const char *input, size_t input_len, const char *filename, int eval_flags);
functions.description: Compile and evaluate JavaScript code in the context with flags controlling mode/module/etc.
requirements: input must be NUL-terminated with input[input_len]=='\0'.
filename must be a NUL-terminated string (used in diagnostics).
eval_flags combine JS_EVAL_TYPE_* and JS_EVAL_FLAG_* bits.
Caller owns returned value or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_EvalThis
functions.signature: JSValue JS_EvalThis(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst this_obj, const char *input, size_t input_len, const char *filename, int eval_flags);
functions.description: Like JS_Eval but with explicit this_obj for direct eval semantics.
requirements: Same as JS_Eval plus this_obj must be a JS value used as this.

functions.name: JS_GetGlobalObject
functions.description: Return the global object of the context.

functions.name: JS_IsInstanceOf
functions.signature: int JS_IsInstanceOf(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst val, JSValueConst obj);
functions.description: Check if val is an instance of constructor/prototype obj; returns 1/0 or <0 on exception.
requirements: obj must be a function object or a prototype-bearing object depending on semantics.

functions.name: JS_DefineProperty
functions.signature: int JS_DefineProperty(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst this_obj, JSAtom prop, JSValueConst val, JSValueConst getter, JSValueConst setter, int flags);
functions.description: Define a property with descriptor fields on an object.
requirements: flags should include JS_PROP_HAS_* to indicate provided fields.
Returns 0/1 or -1 on exception per QuickJS semantics.

functions.name: JS_DefinePropertyValue
functions.signature: int JS_DefinePropertyValue(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst this_obj, JSAtom prop, JSValue val, int flags);
functions.description: Define a property with a value on an object.
requirements: flags may include JS_PROP_C_W_E and JS_PROP_THROW, etc.

functions.name: JS_DefinePropertyValueUint32
functions.signature: int JS_DefinePropertyValueUint32(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst this_obj, uint32_t idx, JSValue val, int flags);
functions.description: Define a numeric-indexed property with a value.

functions.name: JS_DefinePropertyValueStr
functions.signature: int JS_DefinePropertyValueStr(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst this_obj, const char *prop, JSValue val, int flags);
functions.description: Define a string-named property with a value.

functions.name: JS_DefinePropertyGetSet
functions.signature: int JS_DefinePropertyGetSet(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst this_obj, JSAtom prop, JSValue getter, JSValue setter, int flags);
functions.description: Define accessor property (getter/setter) on an object.

functions.name: JS_SetOpaque
functions.description: Associate a native pointer with an object instance of a registered class.
requirements: obj must be an object of a class supporting opaque data.
Opaque pointer is stored without ownership management.

functions.name: JS_GetOpaque
functions.description: Get the native pointer stored in an object if it matches class_id; otherwise NULL.
requirements: class_id must match the object's class.

functions.name: JS_GetOpaque2
functions.description: Like JS_GetOpaque but throws a TypeError in ctx if obj is not of the expected class.
requirements: obj must be an object of the expected class, otherwise an exception is set and NULL returned.

functions.name: JS_GetUserdata
functions.description: Get a user data pointer stored on any object (weolar addition).
requirements: obj must be an object with user data set via JS_SetUserdata/FromClone.

functions.name: JS_SetUserdata
functions.description: Set a user data pointer on an object (weolar addition).

functions.name: JS_SetUserdataFromClone
functions.description: Set user data on a cloned object (testing helper).
requirements: obj must be a cloned object compatible with this API.

functions.name: JS_SetTestVal
functions.description: Set a test value on an object (testing helper).
requirements: v likely consumed or referenced by object; follow test semantics.

functions.name: JS_SetTestValFromClone
functions.description: Set a test value on a cloned object (testing helper).
requirements: obj must be a cloned object.

functions.name: JS_GetTestVal
functions.description: Get a test value previously set on an object (testing helper).

functions.name: JS_ParseJSON
functions.signature: JSValue JS_ParseJSON(JSContext *ctx, const char *buf, size_t buf_len, const char *filename);
functions.description: Parse JSON text from buffer into a JS value.
requirements: buf must be at least buf_len+1 bytes and NUL-terminated (buf[buf_len]=='\0').
filename is for error messages; must be NUL-terminated or NULL.
Caller owns returned value or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_ParseJSON2
functions.signature: JSValue JS_ParseJSON2(JSContext *ctx, const char *buf, size_t buf_len, const char *filename, int flags);
functions.description: Parse JSON with flags (e.g., JS_PARSE_JSON_EXT for extended JSON).

functions.name: JS_JSONStringify
functions.signature: JSValue JS_JSONStringify(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst obj, JSValueConst replacer, JSValueConst space0);
functions.description: Stringify a JS value to JSON with replacer and space parameters.
requirements: Caller owns returned value or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_NewArrayBuffer
functions.signature: JSValue JS_NewArrayBuffer(JSContext *ctx, uint8_t *buf, size_t len, JSFreeArrayBufferDataFunc *free_func, void *opaque, JS_BOOL is_shared);
functions.description: Create an ArrayBuffer from external data with custom free callback.
requirements: buf must point to at least len bytes.
If free_func is non-NULL, it will be called with rt, opaque, and ptr when buffer is freed; buf must remain valid until then.
Caller owns returned value or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_NewArrayBufferCopy
functions.signature: JSValue JS_NewArrayBufferCopy(JSContext *ctx, const uint8_t *buf, size_t len);
functions.description: Create an ArrayBuffer by copying data from a byte buffer.
requirements: buf must point to at least len bytes readable.

functions.name: JS_DetachArrayBuffer
functions.description: Detach an ArrayBuffer, rendering its contents unusable.
requirements: obj must be an ArrayBuffer object.

functions.name: JS_GetArrayBuffer
functions.description: Get a direct pointer to ArrayBuffer backing store and its size.
requirements: psize may be NULL; if non-NULL receives byte length.
Returned pointer becomes invalid if buffer is detached/freed.

functions.name: JS_GetTypedArrayBuffer
functions.signature: JSValue JS_GetTypedArrayBuffer(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst obj, size_t *pbyte_offset, size_t *pbyte_length, size_t *pbytes_per_element);
functions.description: Get the underlying ArrayBuffer of a TypedArray/DataView and metadata.
requirements: pbyte_offset/pbyte_length/pbytes_per_element may be NULL; if non-NULL receive values.
Caller owns returned ArrayBuffer or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_SetSharedArrayBufferFunctions
functions.description: Install host callbacks for SharedArrayBuffer allocation/dup/free.
requirements: sf must point to valid function pointers and opaque; remains valid while used.

functions.name: JS_NewTypedArray
functions.signature: JSValue JS_NewTypedArray(JSContext *ctx, JS_TYPED_ARRAY type, JSValue array_buffer, size_t byte_offset, size_t length);
functions.description: Create a new TypedArray view over an ArrayBuffer.
requirements: array_buffer must be an ArrayBuffer; ownership likely consumed or referenced per implementation.
type must be a valid JS_TYPED_ARRAY.
byte_offset and length must be within buffer bounds.
Caller owns returned value or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_NewPromiseCapability
functions.description: Create a new Promise and return resolving functions in resolving_funcs[0]=resolve, [1]=reject.
requirements: resolving_funcs must point to space for two JSValue entries; caller must free them appropriately.
Caller owns returned Promise value or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_SetHostPromiseRejectionTracker
functions.description: Register a host callback to be notified of unhandled/handled promise rejections.
requirements: cb may be NULL to clear; opaque passed back on callback.

functions.name: JS_SetInterruptHandler
functions.description: Register a callback polled during execution to allow interruption; non-zero return interrupts JS execution.
requirements: cb may be NULL to clear; opaque passed back on callback.

functions.name: JS_SetCanBlock
functions.description: Inform runtime whether Atomics.wait can block in the host environment.

functions.name: JS_SetIsHTMLDDA
functions.description: Set the [IsHTMLDDA] internal slot on an object (affects JS == null semantics in browsers).

functions.name: JS_SetModuleLoaderFunc
functions.description: Set module normalization and loading callbacks for import resolution.
requirements: module_normalize may be NULL to use default normalizer.
module_loader must implement module resolution; may be NULL to disable dynamic loading.

functions.name: JS_GetImportMeta
functions.description: Return the import.meta object for a module.
requirements: m must be a valid module pointer.
Caller owns returned value or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_GetModuleName
functions.description: Return the module's name as an atom.

functions.name: JS_EnqueueJob
functions.signature: int JS_EnqueueJob(JSContext *ctx, JSJobFunc *job_func, int argc, JSValueConst *argv);
functions.description: Enqueue a job (microtask) to be executed later by the job loop.
requirements: job_func must be a function pointer with signature JSJobFunc.
argv must have at least argc entries (may be 0/NULL).

functions.name: JS_IsJobPending
functions.description: Return non-zero if there is at least one pending job in the runtime queue.

functions.name: JS_ExecutePendingJob
functions.description: Execute one pending job from the runtime job queue; returns <0 on exception, 0 if none, >0 if a job was executed.
requirements: pctx may be non-NULL to receive the context in which the job ran.

functions.name: JS_WriteObject
functions.signature: uint8_t *JS_WriteObject(JSContext *ctx, size_t *psize, JSValueConst obj, int flags);
functions.description: Serialize a JS object/function/module to a binary blob for later loading.
requirements: psize must be non-NULL to receive blob size.
obj must be serializable; flags control allowed types (JS_WRITE_OBJ_*).
Returned buffer must be freed with js_free (context allocator).

functions.name: JS_WriteObject2
functions.signature: uint8_t *JS_WriteObject2(JSContext *ctx, size_t *psize, JSValueConst obj, int flags, uint8_t ***psab_tab, size_t *psab_tab_len);
functions.description: Serialize with optional extraction of SharedArrayBuffer references into a table.
requirements: psab_tab and psab_tab_len may be NULL; if non-NULL, receive allocated arrays that caller must free per API.
Returned buffer must be freed with js_free.

functions.name: JS_ReadObject
functions.signature: JSValue JS_ReadObject(JSContext *ctx, const uint8_t *buf, size_t buf_len, int flags);
functions.description: Deserialize a binary blob into a JS object/function/module.
requirements: buf must point to buf_len bytes.
Caller owns returned value or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_EvalFunction
functions.description: Instantiate and evaluate a precompiled function/module returned by JS_ReadObject/JS_Eval with compile-only.
requirements: fun_obj must be a bytecode function/module object.
Caller owns returned value or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_ResolveModule
functions.description: Load and resolve dependencies of a module object (from JS_ReadObject).
requirements: obj must be a module value.

functions.name: JS_GetScriptOrModuleName
functions.description: Return the name (atom) of the current script or module, climbing n_stack_levels frames.

functions.name: JS_RunModule
functions.description: Load, compile, and run a module file (used by os.Worker).
requirements: basename and filename must be NUL-terminated strings.
Returns module pointer or NULL on error.

functions.name: JS_NewCFunction2
functions.signature: JSValue JS_NewCFunction2(JSContext *ctx, JSCFunction *func, const char *name, int length, JSCFunctionEnum cproto, int magic, void* userdata);
functions.description: Create a new JS function wrapping a C callback with metadata, magic value, and optional userdata.
requirements: func must be a function pointer matching cproto.
name must be NUL-terminated or NULL for anonymous.
length is the function length property.
cproto must be a valid JSCFunctionEnum describing the callback type.
Caller owns returned function or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_NewCFunctionData
functions.signature: JSValue JS_NewCFunctionData(JSContext *ctx, JSCFunctionData *func, int length, int magic, int data_len, JSValueConst *data);
functions.description: Create a C function with embedded function data accessible from callback.
requirements: func must be a valid callback.
data_len may be 0; if >0, data must point to at least data_len entries.
Caller owns returned function or must handle exception.

functions.name: JS_NewCFunction
functions.signature: static inline JSValue JS_NewCFunction(JSContext *ctx, JSCFunction *func, const char *name, int length);
functions.description: Convenience to create a generic C function without magic/userdata.
requirements: Same as JS_NewCFunction2 with cproto=JS_CFUNC_generic, magic=0, userdata=NULL.

functions.name: JS_NewCFunctionMagic
functions.signature: static inline JSValue JS_NewCFunctionMagic(JSContext *ctx, JSCFunctionMagic *func, const char *name, int length, JSCFunctionEnum cproto, int magic);
functions.description: Convenience to create a C function with magic value.
requirements: Same as JS_NewCFunction2 with provided cproto and magic, userdata=NULL.

functions.name: JS_SetConstructor
functions.signature: void JS_SetConstructor(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst func_obj, JSValueConst proto);
functions.description: Set the 'prototype' property of a constructor function and link constructor on the prototype.
requirements: func_obj must be a function object.

functions.name: JS_SetPropertyFunctionList
functions.signature: void JS_SetPropertyFunctionList(JSContext *ctx, JSValueConst obj, const JSCFunctionListEntry *tab, int len);

func must have the matching union member set.

functions.name: JS_PrintStack
functions.description: Print the current JS stack for debugging.

functions.name: JS_NewCModule
functions.description: Create a new C-defined module with name and initializer callback.
requirements: func must be a valid initializer returning 0 on success when called by loader.
Must be called before instantiation per module system.

functions.name: JS_AddModuleExport
functions.description: Declare a named export from a C module before instantiation.
requirements: m must be a module created by JS_NewCModule.
Can only be called before the module is instantiated (comment).

functions.signature: int JS_AddModuleExportList(JSContext *ctx, JSModuleDef *m, const JSCFunctionListEntry *tab, int len);

functions.name: JS_SetModuleExport
functions.signature: int JS_SetModuleExport(JSContext *ctx, JSModuleDef *m, const char *export_name, JSValue val);
functions.description: Assign an exported value on an instantiated C module.
requirements: m must be an instantiated module.

functions.name: JS_SetModuleExportList
functions.signature: int JS_SetModuleExportList(JSContext *ctx, JSModuleDef *m, const JSCFunctionListEntry *tab, int len);
functions.description: Assign multiple exports on an instantiated C module from a list.
